metadata.title: The Windows SMB client must be configured to always perform SMB packet signing.

criterion.comment: Verifies 'Microsoft Network Client: Digitally sign communications (always)' is set to 'Enabled'

metadata.title: WN11-SO-000100 - The Windows SMB client must be configured to always perform SMB packet signing.
metadata.description: The server message block (SMB) protocol provides the basis for many network operations. Digitally signed SMB packets aid in preventing man-in-the-middle attacks. If this policy is enabled, the SMB client will only communicate with an SMB server that performs SMB packet signing.

registry_test.comment: 'Microsoft Network Client: Digitally sign communications (always)' is set to 'Enabled'

registry_object.comment: Check the registry value store at HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanWorkstation\Parameters\RequireSecuritySignature
registry_object.name: RequireSecuritySignature
